title: EEG and autonomic responses during emotional word association
description: This dataset contains synchronized EEG, autonomic physiological recordings, and behavioral responses collected during an emotional word association task centered on fear-related concepts. Participants either selected suggested words or generated new ones. Eight-channel EEG, electrodermal activity, blood volume pulse, interbeat interval, skin temperature, and word events with semantic similarity scores between consecutive words are included.
methods_description: EEG was recorded at 250 Hz from 8 channels (Fp1, Fp2, F3, F4, P7, P8, O1, O2) using an OpenBCI Cyton board with an Ultracortex Mark IV headset and ear-clip electrodes. Autonomic signals (EDA, BVP, IBI, skin temperature) were recorded with an Empatica E4 wristband. All streams were timestamped for synchronization with word selection and generation events. Sessions lasted approximately three minutes.
